caption: One measured boot on a 0–10 s timeline. The bootloader (3 s) and kernel load (4 s) fill 7 of the 10 s; init adds only 1 s before the login prompt.

spec.aria: A timeline from 0 to 10 seconds: firmware 0 to 2 s, bootloader 2 to 5 s, kernel load 5 to 9 s, init 9 to 10 s, then the login prompt at 10 s.
